scope: pipeline/projects, operations, dashboard, migrations and bundled Lean measurement comparison script
method: Read every module contract and complete function body, including validators, methods, nested helpers and frozen SQL DDL. Evaluate necessity, contracts, failure handling, comments, efficiency and shared abstractions; then record source-bound dispositions. Metrics do not establish review.
hash_contract: File SHA-256 uses exact file bytes; function SHA-256 uses UTF-8 source lines source_start_line through end_line inclusive, including decorators and original newline bytes. line is the AST definition line.

D01.summary: Falsy YAML scalar/sequence metadata bypassed object validation; nested NaN/infinity reached JSON serialization.

D02.summary: Nonobject diagnostic retention markers and backup manifests crashed cleanup preview instead of preserving unrecognized state.

D03.summary: Health evidence accepted contradictory run and assignment scopes in the same project and nonfinite JSON values; snapshot contract exposed unsupported assignment storage scope.

D04.summary: Window queue ranks changed after cursor/session filtering; one shared full-run pending queue subquery now supplies absolute positions.

D05.summary: Primary session usage sums discarded the uncertainty flag from constituent threads.

D06.summary: Nonstring UUID cursor identities raised AttributeError instead of an invalid_cursor domain response.

D07.summary: Project workflow changes treated stopping runs as idle even though their ownership was not settled.

D08.summary: Failed search generation deletion left cleanup fences stuck; readiness was exposed before final cleanup and failed entries retained loaded indexes.

functions.name: Scope.requires_target

functions.name: Scope.ids

functions.name: HealthSnapshotSpec.supported_scope

functions.name: _scope_key

functions.name: _dedupe
functions.assessment: Bound scope/code/external fingerprints into a fixed SHA-256 database key; retain kind separation.

functions.name: _validate_json_object
functions.assessment: Reject unserializable and nonfinite nested payload values before database mutation instead of relying on PostgreSQL JSON errors.

functions.name: _validate_scope
functions.assessment: Retain project containment and reject an assignment from another run even in the same project, preventing contradictory scoped evidence.

functions.name: upsert_health_issue
functions.assessment: Transaction lock and row lock preserve one revisioned observation count; resolved issues reopen and explicit suppression remains durable.

functions.name: capture_health_snapshot
functions.assessment: Immutable dedupe replays the first snapshot for a scope/key; validate payload/scope before using the database and keep caller capture time.

functions.name: propose_control_plan
functions.assessment: Explicit project/run containment, stable proposal identity and expected revision prevent stale initial plans; repeated proposal returns prior durable intent.

functions.name: accept_control_plan

functions.name: apply_control_plan
functions.assessment: Guard both run revision and optional frontier before marking applied; the caller must execute domain mutations in the same transaction.

files.assessment: Conservative owned cleanup, explicit retention and snapshot/blob-consistent backups. Unrecognized metadata stays protected; backup integrity checks are not a restore proof.

functions.name: service_logging
functions.assessment: Bound only owned diagnostic files, preserve previous logger configuration and close handler on exit; explicit zero disables service log storage.

functions.name: service_logging.BoundedHandler.format
functions.assessment: UTF-8 byte truncation keeps a single record below its rotation chunk, including multibyte messages.

functions.name: service_logging.BoundedHandler.shouldRollover
functions.assessment: Byte-size rollover is necessary because text character counts do not match encoded on-disk size.

functions.name: pressure
functions.assessment: Keep cleanup target separate from admission byte floor/emergency percentage; calculate from nearest existing ancestor and return an observation timestamp.

functions.name: StorageManager.__init__
functions.assessment: Store explicit service state root and policy; no implicit directory creation or operator-state discovery.

functions.name: StorageManager.cleanup_preview
functions.assessment: Only marked resolved terminal unpinned nonsymlink diagnostics qualify. Malformed nonobject JSON now remains protected instead of crashing maintenance.

functions.name: StorageManager.backup_preview
functions.assessment: Verify checksums, reject symlink trees and preserve the newest verified backup even if over budget; corrupt/unrecognized candidates remain untouched.

functions.name: StorageManager.cleanup
functions.assessment: Exclusive lock and recomputed marker digests revalidate reviewed candidates before rename/delete; operator repinning wins over an earlier preview.

functions.name: database_retention_preview
functions.assessment: Bound transport-only deletion candidates and protect live receipts, bootstrap/launch IDs, semantic events and notification references.

functions.name: apply_database_retention
functions.assessment: Recompute eligibility under transactional serialization and intersect IDs/revisions with the reviewed batch; no unrelated history is eligible.

functions.name: postgres_environment
functions.assessment: Remove ambient PostgreSQL settings before populating explicit URL connection/SSL options; subprocess credentials remain in environment rather than arguments.

functions.name: backup
functions.assessment: Keep exported repeatable-read snapshot alive through pg_dump and blob copy, fsync before atomic publish, redact config and retain partial diagnostic output on failure.

functions.name: verify_backup
functions.assessment: Require a manifest object before accessing fields, verify database digest and each artifact size/digest; this is integrity validation, not a substitute for restore testing.

functions.name: make_tracer_provider

functions.name: RequestTelemetry.__init__

functions.name: RequestTelemetry.__call__

functions.name: RequestTelemetry.__call__.tracked_send

functions.name: check_worker

functions.name: _record_check

functions.assessment: Retain admin authorization, transaction serialization and recipe hash replay; the durable receipt prevents one launch ID starting a second differently configured run.

functions.name: expanded
functions.assessment: Preset expansion is useful explicit setup composition; generated reviewer/policy keys are checked together for duplicates and reserved operator identity before mutation.

functions.name: resolve
functions.assessment: Recursive earlier-record references keep recipes declarative; unknown references fail before creating dependent records, with linear traversal of the recipe payload.

functions.name: preview
functions.assessment: Keep deterministic dry validation, full OID and opaque credential-reference checks; the plan describes atomic local effects and deliberately starts no run.

functions.name: operator
functions.assessment: Local setup must resolve a live human administrator; keep the disabled-principal and installation-grant checks rather than inventing a privileged actor.

functions.name: apply
functions.assessment: Retain reviewed digest replay and shared catalog/lifecycle services inside the caller transaction; preset repository-purpose checks can roll back all prior recipe records.

files.assessment: Shared typed catalog mutation and normalized relations. Identity/lifecycle fields stay with domain services; revision and transactional ownership boundaries remain explicit.

functions.name: _claim_attached_limits
functions.assessment: Reservations account real unconfirmed executions and live native children; ordered row locks and existing-claim lookup protect limit reattachment without assuming processes stopped.

functions.name: configure_host_harness
functions.assessment: Keep host-revision CAS across normalized harness links, resource-limit row locks and occupancy backfill; detaching a limit cannot release a still-live process reservation.

functions.name: validate_references
functions.assessment: Catalog writes need explicit same-project relationships, bibliographic uniqueness, policy identity/perspective scope and DAG checks. The branches enforce separate domain invariants.

functions.name: update_catalog
functions.assessment: Keep immutable-field whitelist, complete create-contract revalidation, revision checks and relation snapshots. Workflow transitions require a human and idle project, including settled stopping runs; read-dependent writes stay transactional.

functions.name: create_catalog
functions.assessment: Shared creation is necessary for API and recipes; retain authorization, typed references, workspace-root boundary, normalized joins, JSON conversion and source revision snapshots.

files.assessment: Authenticated immutable evidence ingestion, keeping content-addressed blob writes separate from database artifact attribution.

functions.name: BlobUpload.one_content
functions.assessment: Exactly one JSON or base64 source avoids ambiguous upload identity; null JSON is intentionally treated as absent by this contract.

functions.name: upload
functions.assessment: Preserve worker project scope, live execution attribution and disk admission check; content-addressed blobs reuse existing project evidence and assignment links without duplicating storage.

files.assessment: Portable safe front matter parsing and JSON metadata normalization. Body preservation and rejection of falsy nonobjects/nonfinite numbers are covered by regressions.

functions.name: _json_value
functions.assessment: Retain date normalization, string-key checking and active-container cycle detection. Reject nonfinite floats before PostgreSQL/JSON serialization; repeated nonrecursive aliases remain valid.

functions.name: parse_document
functions.assessment: Keep safe YAML constructors, optional JSON fallback and original body line endings. Falsy scalar/sequence metadata must fail the object contract instead of becoming an empty object.

files.assessment: Planning-neutral compiler receipts retain old table/hash identities for saved evidence. Generic library proof closure is separate from legacy milestone contract semantics.

functions.name: digest
functions.assessment: Canonical hash serialization is an immutable evidence compatibility boundary; retain existing separators/key order rather than replacing it with a different shared hash.

functions.name: register_check
functions.assessment: Keep host authority, ready workspace and repository-kind checks, compiled/axiom validation, proof evidence provenance and content hash deduplication. Library receipts require no milestone graph.

functions.name: head_check
functions.assessment: This narrow query selects the latest nonproof immutable receipt for one repository and exact PR head; proof receipts must not replace statement/graph evidence.

files.assessment: Retained explicit compatibility imports only; old integration entrypoint delegates to planning-neutral verification service and duplicates no business logic.
Legacy portable source-contract parsing never executes repository code. Its strict milestone schema belongs to explicitly retained workflows.

functions.name: Milestone.accepted_contract
functions.assessment: Explicit legacy accepted statement claims require a contract and precise citations; the validator protects claims without choosing an agent plan.

functions.name: digest
functions.assessment: Keep canonical source manifest digest stable for existing immutable comparisons; this serialization contract matches receipt hashing without speculative consolidation.

functions.name: validate_edges
functions.assessment: Kahn traversal validates missing targets and cycles in O(V+E), deduplicating repeated edges; retain it instead of recursive traversal of large source graphs.

functions.name: source_manifest
functions.assessment: Retain nonexecuting parsing, objective-root/declaration/module/definition invariants and full Lean input freezing for explicit milestone workflows. Generated proof/status claims are excluded from contract identity.

functions.name: milestone_table
functions.assessment: Small deterministic legacy status renderer escapes table separators/newlines and excludes retired claims; no shared rendering abstraction is needed for this one format.

files.assessment: Legacy strict baseline acceptance remains opt-in; existing review/receipt provenance is preserved. Long acceptance/view functions coordinate separate real invariants and do not justify mechanical splitting.

functions.name: enabled
functions.assessment: The explicit project workflow guard is necessary to keep strict milestone acceptance away from graph-default projects.

functions.name: projected_manifest
functions.assessment: Only a complete exact-commit source projection can support acceptance; reject partial/stale rows rather than mixing repository revisions.

functions.name: review_panel
functions.assessment: Retain explicit legacy compiler, route and perspective coverage checks, current review provenance and advisory-policy escape. Latest review lookup is bounded by configured descriptors; it does not invent mathematical acceptance.

functions.name: accepted_gate
functions.assessment: Accepted ancestor evidence must bind repository, merged head, gate, receipt kind and current policy revision; keep these checks before baseline freezing.

functions.name: accept_baseline
functions.assessment: Legacy baseline acceptance coordinates human/automatic authority, exact indexed manifest, citations, target compiler evidence and reviewed route/contract provenance. Keep the full transaction and separate immutable evidence records.

functions.name: require_baseline
functions.assessment: Formalization baseline enforcement belongs only to explicit milestone projects; retain frozen/acceptance checks and early graph-workflow return.

functions.name: _initial_baseline_readiness
functions.assessment: This diagnostic reports indexed-source receipt availability, not full acceptance or human approval. Keep exact source/digest matching and clearly scoped next-action templates.

functions.name: objective_view
functions.assessment: Read view derives proof/statement status from exact manifest-linked receipts and reviewed gates, with bounded evidence lists and authorization; source claims alone cannot prove completion.

files.assessment: Worker-portable bounded disposable bibliographic cache. Endpoint auth revalidation, local revision monotonicity, symlink boundaries and GPFS access clock are purposeful.

functions.name: CachedReference.text
functions.assessment: UTF-8 decoding convenience is appropriate for already verified export bytes; invalid stored/network UTF-8 is rejected earlier.

functions.name: ReferenceCache.__init__
functions.assessment: Keep explicit endpoint/credential validation, local-HTTP exception, token-scoped cache identity and bounded owned HTTP client. It never fetches publication metadata URLs.

functions.name: ReferenceCache._ensure_directory
functions.assessment: Cache directories must remain nonsymlink directories inside the resolved workspace; preserve these checks before reads and lock acquisition.

functions.name: ReferenceCache._lock
functions.assessment: Cross-process flock and O_NOFOLLOW serialize local cache mutation; fd cleanup occurs even after failed acquisition or caller errors.

functions.name: ReferenceCache._key
functions.assessment: Scope plus UUID hashing separates endpoints/credentials without storing token text in filenames.

functions.name: ReferenceCache._paths
functions.assessment: Fixed digest-derived metadata/body filenames are sufficient; do not generalize to arbitrary caller paths.

functions.name: ReferenceCache._etag
functions.assessment: Restrict validators to bounded single-line weak/strong ETags; invalid remote metadata cannot become request headers.

functions.name: ReferenceCache._read_file
functions.assessment: Bound bytes both from stat and read while refusing symlink files, because corrupt disposable cache content is not trusted input.

functions.name: ReferenceCache._load
functions.assessment: Validate schema/scope/UUID/revision/ETag/size/hash/UTF-8 and discard invalid pairs. Local permission failures may still surface while deleting an unusable cache.

functions.name: ReferenceCache._replace
functions.assessment: Same-directory temporary write, fsync and atomic replace protect each cache component; finally removes an unfinished incoming file.

functions.name: ReferenceCache._access_clock
functions.assessment: Logical access timestamps are necessary on GPFS; scanning bounded metadata under the cache lock avoids tied or stale filesystem mtimes affecting eviction order.

functions.name: ReferenceCache._prune
functions.assessment: Retain cleanup of incoming/orphan/symlink pairs and oldest-access eviction under count/byte bounds; the just-verified requested entry is protected.

functions.name: ReferenceCache.get
functions.assessment: Every hit revalidates authorization remotely, handles revoked/missing records, retries inconsistent 304 once and streams a bounded UTF-8 export. No offline fallback bypasses access checks.

functions.name: ReferenceCache._store
functions.assessment: Monotonic revisions and same-revision digest checks prevent stale network completion overwriting newer content; atomically save bytes/metadata then enforce quota.

functions.name: ReferenceCache.close
functions.assessment: Close only the client this cache owns, preserving injected shared transport ownership.

functions.name: ReferenceCache.__enter__
functions.assessment: Context-manager entry returns the configured cache without additional effects.

functions.name: ReferenceCache.__exit__
functions.assessment: Context-manager exit delegates owned transport release and preserves exceptions.

files.assessment: Pure canonical identifier parsing with no network side effects. ISBN uses an established checksum dependency; arXiv version grouping is identity policy.

functions.name: _input
functions.assessment: Single bounded nonblank UTF-8 input guard is a useful shared boundary for all normalizers.

functions.name: _resolver_path
functions.assessment: Recognized public HTTP(S) resolver hosts with no userinfo prevent arbitrary URL interpretation; parsing performs no network I/O.

functions.name: normalize_doi
functions.assessment: Retain resolver/prefix handling and canonical lowercase DOI validation; suffix punctuation is part of DOI identity rather than stripped heuristically.

functions.name: normalize_arxiv
functions.assessment: Modern/legacy publication periods, sequence lengths and version syntax serve distinct identity formats; retain precise validation rather than one permissive regex.

functions.name: arxiv_key
functions.assessment: Catalog identity groups versions and redundant legacy category tags while preserving the versioned identifier in metadata.

functions.name: normalize_isbn
functions.assessment: Use the maintained checksum library and canonical conversion; translate its validation exception into the model boundary error.

functions.name: normalize_pmid
functions.assessment: Strip recognized prefixes/resolvers and canonicalize positive bounded integer identifiers, rejecting zero and unrelated URLs.

functions.name: normalize_identifier
functions.assessment: Whitelist dispatch avoids unsupported identifier kinds and keeps validation centralized.

functions.name: identifier_key
functions.assessment: The arXiv identity exception is deliberate; all other identifiers share their canonical normalized value.

files.assessment: Project bibliographic identity, usage and structured BibTeX export; fixed SQL expression operands preserve indexed lookup with prepared plans.

functions.name: identifier_expression
functions.assessment: Fixed PostgreSQL expression operands preserve expression-index matching under prepared generic plans; the identifier kind is whitelisted before SQL construction.

functions.name: reject_duplicate
functions.assessment: Project-scoped citation/identifier conflict lookup is necessary for meaningful 409 diagnostics before immutable catalog identity is reused.

functions.name: record_usage
functions.assessment: Retain worker authorization and same-project object/path resolution before recording citation usage; immutable citation spelling and structured BibTeX are returned together.

functions.name: bibtex
functions.assessment: Translate structured writer failures into useful metadata validation errors; callers need one export boundary instead of handling library exceptions.

functions.name: _bibtex
functions.assessment: Map catalog kinds, venue fields, canonical identifiers and structured author names through pybtex; avoid handwritten BibTeX escaping.

files.assessment: One owned bounded asynchronous generation cache with pinned sources, active reader protection and explicit shutdown. Retained-size values are estimates, not runtime performance claims.

functions.name: _tree_bytes
functions.assessment: Nonsymlink recursive byte accounting is needed for disk admission and Git monitoring; tolerate disappearing files without treating symlinks as owned content.

functions.name: _retained_bytes
functions.assessment: Recursive retained-size estimate handles shared containers, dataclasses and NumPy buffers once. This is a conservative accounting heuristic, not a measured peak-memory guarantee.

functions.name: SearchManager.__init__
functions.assessment: Retain explicit root/budgets, singleton flock, crash-stage cleanup and engine-versioned cache identity; the owned executor makes expensive work asynchronous to reads.

functions.name: SearchManager.validate_source
functions.assessment: Pin full OIDs, canonical relative subdirs and operator-allowlisted origins; local file sources require an explicit root and remote HTTP is disallowed.

functions.name: SearchManager.generation_key
functions.assessment: Include project/source identity and engine generation with the immutable source spec; cross-project or extractor-version cache reuse must not collide.

functions.name: SearchManager._payload
functions.assessment: Small state serialization exposes readiness and bounded errors without returning credentials or local filesystem paths.

functions.name: SearchManager.prepare
functions.assessment: Short metadata lock deduplicates generations, bounds queued preparation and supports explicit failed retry; never block browser reads on Git/index creation.

functions.name: SearchManager.search
functions.assessment: Validate mode/query/result count, initiate preparation and pin ready generations while querying; truncate public documentation/header snippets.

functions.name: SearchManager.pin
functions.assessment: Readers increment/decrement under lock, keeping a queried generation from eviction; absent/not-ready entries yield no index.

functions.name: SearchManager._evict
functions.assessment: Choose LRU candidates while preserving active readers/builds and reservation accounting; fail explicitly when retained generations prevent satisfying budgets.

functions.name: SearchManager._remove_retired
functions.assessment: Disk deletion stays outside the metadata lock; only remove accounting after successful deletion. Release all cleanup fences in finally so transient filesystem failures can be retried.

functions.name: SearchManager._prepare
functions.assessment: Keep staged clone/build/publish/reopen, generation budgets, warmup and shutdown cancellation. Expose readiness only after cleanup succeeds and release any index from failed preparation; completed disk generations survive orderly shutdown.

functions.name: SearchManager._load_generation
functions.assessment: Manifest, pinned HEAD and clean checkout checks decide cache reuse; unreadable/stale caches rebuild while shutdown cancellation propagates.

functions.name: SearchManager._clone
functions.assessment: Fetch only the exact shallow commit with scoped environment Authorization, then verify detached HEAD; invalid header values fail before fetch.

functions.name: SearchManager._git
functions.assessment: No hooks/ambient Git config/interactive credentials/redirects, bounded disk diagnostics, cancellation and process-group kill are purposeful trust/resource boundaries.

functions.name: SearchManager._check_stopping
functions.assessment: One explicit cancellation check is shared by Git, extraction and index serialization so shutdown does not masquerade as corruption.

functions.name: SearchManager.stats
functions.assessment: Return aggregate memory/disk/reservation/reader/readiness observations under the metadata lock; these are cache accounting values.

functions.name: SearchManager.close
functions.assessment: Set shutdown before joining owned executor, then release singleton lock; repeated close is harmless.

functions.name: SearchManager.__enter__
functions.assessment: Context-manager entry exposes the existing manager and owner lifetime.

functions.name: SearchManager.__exit__
functions.assessment: Context-manager exit joins work and releases cache ownership through close.

files.assessment: Exact-input leased host checks with separate generic library and explicit legacy milestone admission; receipt persistence retains historical storage names.

functions.name: VerificationRequest.proof_inputs
functions.assessment: Require comparator input trio atomically and prohibit mixing library checks with legacy comparator jobs; this prevents partially specified immutable work.

functions.name: queue_library
functions.assessment: The typed generic wrapper intentionally omits milestone manifest/baseline requirements and marks only library verification.

functions.name: Finish.outcome
functions.assessment: Successful report and failure diagnostic are mutually exclusive; validation prevents ambiguous lease settlement.

functions.name: queue
functions.assessment: Keep project/workspace/host capability checks, exact JSON input dedupe and separate library versus explicit milestone admission. Solution checkout must share project/host and be ready.

functions.name: claim
functions.assessment: Host authority, mode guard, SKIP LOCKED lease selection and three lost-lease bound are necessary; invalidated workspaces fail before dispatch and library-only hosts skip legacy jobs.

functions.name: live_job
functions.assessment: Current token, running status and database-time lease expiry fence worker settlement; a stale worker cannot finish a reclaimed job.

functions.name: heartbeat
functions.assessment: Use the common lease guard before extending 300-second ownership from database time.

functions.name: finish
functions.assessment: Receipt kind and all immutable commit inputs must match the live job before registering evidence and recording completed/failed status in the same transaction.

files.assessment: Standalone stdlib numeric comparison of preexisting Radar JSONL. Provenance is supplied by the caller; no benchmark is executed or direction of improvement assumed.

functions.name: finite
functions.assessment: Reject booleans, nonnumbers, integer conversion overflow and NaN/infinity; finite arithmetic is required for valid exported JSON.

functions.name: read_measurements
functions.assessment: Read existing JSONL only, require metric/unit/value shape, sum repeated compatible units and attach path/line errors; empty/mixed/overflow data fails.

functions.name: compare
functions.assessment: Preserve missing-side and mismatched-unit metrics rather than invent improvements; zero baseline has no percent and overflow arithmetic fails explicitly.

functions.name: commit_oid
functions.assessment: CLI provenance pins require complete lowercase 40/64-character Git identities; caller-supplied provenance is accurately labelled.

functions.name: main
functions.assessment: Standalone tool validates context and files before numeric report serialization; never executes benchmark code or modifies input measurements.
